_comment: Per-contract WASM size budgets for the release build (#956). Budget = measured size + 5% headroom. The token budget reflects lock_tokens, withdraw_locked (#1076, #1077), role proposals (#914, #918, #1308), and the per-minter allowances, scheduled mint streams and storage/TTL diagnostics added in #1374; vesting links the token crate, so that same code is included in its WASM. The rate-limit and split budgets are raised by #914/#918 as well: both contracts link the bc-forge-admin crate, whose privileged-action timelock, role renounce, and proposal listing additions compile into their WASMs. Split is raised again for the basis-point allocation entry points (#1463); vesting is raised again for get_schedule, top_up_schedule and cancel_milestone (#1460-#1462).
_measured_on: cargo 1.96.0, wasm32-unknown-unknown, --release, zero warnings. #914/#918 re-measured on 1.94.0; rate-limit/split re-measured on 1.96.0; token/vesting re-measured on 1.96.0 (#1308); token re-measured on 1.96.0 after #1374 (206864 bytes, budget 218000). Split/vesting re-measured with #1460-#1463 applied.
